description: Serial per the Wikipedia survivor list; acquired Oct 2022 via an anonymous donation and identified by the museum as an aircraft that trained at Walnut Ridge Army Air Field in WWII; museum vehicles page lists a 1941 BT-13A; currency Talk Business and Politics 31 Mar 2025 (two BT-13s on display) and a Somewhere In Arkansas visit report of Nov 2025

FAA registry: Consolidated Vultee BT-13B (SNV-2) s/n 79-1366 registered to Walnut Ridge Army Flying School Museum Inc and valid to Jun 2031; a Navy SNV-2 airframe displayed as a BT-13B; museum page lists a 1942 BT-13B; the second BT-13 came from Newport AR per the Jonesboro Sun 2022; currency Talk Business and Politics 31 Mar 2025
